#111 · Widget sync current · read just now
#112  Draft the shard sync protocol
[In Review]  @mara-vos  #501 open ci ok ch

DESCRIPTION

  The shard sync protocol has to survive
  a shard going away mid-transfer &
  coming back with a different
  generation number.

  ## Shape

  1. The sender announces  (shard,
  generation, offset) .
  2. The receiver either accepts or
  replies with the offset it wants.
  3. Either side may abort; an aborted
  transfer leaves no partial state.

  Open question: do we version the
  handshake itself, or rely on the
  generation number to carry it? Leaning
  towards an explicit version — see the
  linked ticket.
